newsitem.title: USA: US OMB's Raines says budget differences manageable.
newsitem.headline: US OMB's Raines says budget differences manageable.

text.p: Office of Management and Budget Director Franklin Raines said Thursday remaining budget differences with congressional Republicans were "manageable" and that an agreement could be concluded by day's end.

"Right now all of the remaining issues I think are manageable and just hopeful that we will be able to conclude negotiations very quickly," Raines told reporters after leaving a meeting with congressional Republicans.
"We are still trying to dot the last I's and cross the last T's. We are very hopeful that we will be able to conclude the written agreement before the end of the day," Raines said.
White House Economic Adviser Gene Sperling said the administration had been given assurances that $35 billion in education tax credits sought by President Clinton would be included in the budget.
